items.reason: R4 lists GM-CSF/sargramostim given to support a vaccine as part of the excluded therapy. Here it is dosed on the SurVaxM schedule ('100 mcg per dose, dosed every two weeks for 4 doses and then every 3 months', identical to SurVaxM and Montanide) and has no arm or outcome of its own, so the R4 exception does not apply. Agreed coding (excluded_intervention_type; pembrolizumab experimental_monotherapy) stands.

R4 lists GM-CSF/sargramostim given to support a vaccine as part of the excluded therapy. Here it is dosed on the SurVaxM schedule ('100 mcg per dose, dosed every two weeks for 4 doses and then every 3 months', identical to SurVaxM and Montanide) and has no arm or outcome of its own, so the R4 exception does not apply. Agreed coding (excluded_intervention_type; pembrolizumab experimental_monotherapy) stands.

note: historical because 'World Health Organization Grade IV glioma (glioblastoma or gliosarcoma)' without IDH (agreed). Sargramostim and Montanide are part of the excluded vaccine therapy (D30-R4, D31-B8).
